about: Golden vectors for the format reservation of D-34 and D-132 and for documents v1 and v2 (DAN-453 PR 0, contract on #1091, attack plan #1258). All data is invented.
Every rejected segment is an accepted segment of evidence-v3.json with one reserved value added; the base stays accepted, so the reservation alone is refused.
pinnedFiles holds the SHA-256 of evidence-v2.json and evidence-v3.json as they are: the reservation changes none of their bytes.
Derived outside the repository code: Python json.dumps with sorted keys and compact separators (JCS for this ASCII data) and hashlib.sha256. Never regenerate them from the code under test.

documentsV2 and rejectedDocumentsV2 follow docs/contracts/document-schema-v2.md (DAN-619 PR a); document v2 is accepted, so documentSchemaVersions reserves nothing. The v2 text holds non-ASCII characters (escaped here as JSON); utf8Hex was derived with ensure_ascii=False and UTF-8, and every key is ASCII, so the sorted order is the JCS order. Each rejected document lists every expected error as [path, code].
